source: O*NET 30.0 Database, Task Statements (U.S. Department of Labor/ETA, CC BY 4.0)
labels_note: automate / assist / human labels were drafted with AI assistance; a label counts as checked only when reviewed_by is filled.

tasks.text: Compile, sort, and verify the accuracy of data before it is entered.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Document-reading AI already extracts and checks fields from invoices and forms.

tasks.text: Compare data with source documents, or re-enter data in verification format to detect errors.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Comparing entries with source documents is rule-based and is done by validation software.

tasks.text: Store completed documents in appropriate locations.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Digital filing and records systems store documents automatically.

tasks.text: Locate and correct data entry errors, or report them to supervisors.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Software flags likely errors, but a person decides the correction and when to escalate.

tasks.text: Select materials needed to complete work assignments.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Planning one's own work and materials stays with the person.

tasks.text: Create, maintain, and enter information into databases.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Entering and updating database records is increasingly done by forms, integrations and document AI.

tasks.text: Review work done by others to check for correct spelling and grammar, ensure that company format policies are followed, and recommend revisions.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Grammar and style tools check text; a person judges tone and company context.

tasks.text: Compose, type, and distribute meeting notes, routine correspondence, or reports, such as presentations or expense, statistical, or monthly reports.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Generative AI drafts notes and reports; a person checks facts and sends them.

tasks.text: Answer telephones and give information to callers, take messages, or transfer calls to appropriate individuals.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Voice assistants route routine calls; people handle the rest.

tasks.text: Greet visitors or callers and handle their inquiries or direct them to the appropriate persons according to their needs.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Welcoming visitors in person depends on presence and judgement.

tasks.text: Train and assist staff with computer usage.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Training colleagues needs patience, trust and knowing the team.

tasks.text: Keep records of customer interactions or transactions, recording details of inquiries, complaints, or comments, as well as actions taken.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Contact-centre software logs and summarises interactions automatically.

tasks.text: Determine charges for services requested, collect deposits or payments, or arrange for billing.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Charges and billing follow rules that systems apply.

tasks.text: Complete contract forms, prepare change of address records, or issue service discontinuance orders, using computers.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Standard forms and account changes are handled by self-service and workflow tools.

tasks.text: Confer with customers by telephone or in person to provide information about products or services, take or enter orders, cancel accounts, or obtain details of complaints.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Chatbots answer routine questions; people handle complex or upset customers with AI-suggested answers.

tasks.text: Contact customers to respond to inquiries or to notify them of claim investigation results or any planned adjustments.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Notifications can be drafted and sent by AI; sensitive news still needs a person.

tasks.text: Refer unresolved customer grievances to designated departments for further investigation.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Deciding how to handle an unresolved complaint takes judgement and ownership.

roles.onet_note: Closest O*NET occupation: Business Intelligence Analysts.

tasks.text: Generate standard or custom reports summarizing business, financial, or economic data for review by executives, managers, clients, and other stakeholders.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Standard reports are generated on a schedule by BI tools.

tasks.text: Collect business intelligence data from available industry reports, public information, field reports, or purchased sources.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI gathers and summarises sources; a person judges which are reliable.

tasks.text: Maintain or update business intelligence tools, databases, dashboards, systems, or methods.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI helps write queries and dashboard code; the analyst designs and maintains them.

tasks.text: Create business intelligence tools or systems, including design of related databases, spreadsheets, or outputs.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI speeds up building tools; deciding what to build stays with the analyst.

tasks.text: Identify and analyze industry or geographic trends with business strategy implications.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Linking trends to business strategy needs context and accountability.

tasks.text: Synthesize current business intelligence or trend data to support recommendations for action.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Recommending action is a judgement the analyst owns.

tasks.text: Clean and manipulate raw data using statistical software.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI coding tools speed up data cleaning; the engineer checks the result.

tasks.text: Analyze, manipulate, or process large sets of data using statistical software.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Analysis is faster with AI help, but the engineer designs and verifies it.

tasks.text: Apply feature selection algorithms to models predicting outcomes of interest, such as sales, attrition, and healthcare use.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AutoML tries feature sets; the engineer judges what is valid and fair.

tasks.text: Compare models using statistical performance metrics, such as loss functions or proportion of explained variance.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Metrics are computed automatically; choosing the right one is a judgement.

tasks.text: Identify business problems or management objectives that can be addressed through data analysis.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Framing the right problem needs business understanding.

tasks.text: Deliver oral or written presentations of the results of mathematical modeling and data analysis to management or other end users.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Explaining results and limits to decision makers stays with people.

roles.onet_note: A new role with no O*NET occupation yet, so we do not show tasks for it rather than guess.

tasks.text: Modify existing software to correct errors, adapt it to new hardware, or upgrade interfaces and improve performance.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI coding assistants propose fixes; developers review and own them.

tasks.text: Develop or direct software system testing or validation procedures, programming, or documentation.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI writes test and documentation drafts; developers decide what must be tested.

tasks.text: Design, develop and modify software systems, using scientific analysis and mathematical models to predict and measure outcomes and consequences of design.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI generates code; design and trade-offs stay with the developer.

tasks.text: Determine system performance standards.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Tools measure performance; setting the standard is a decision.

tasks.text: Analyze user needs and software requirements to determine feasibility of design within time and cost constraints.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Understanding what users need and what is feasible needs conversation and judgement.

tasks.text: Confer with systems analysts, engineers, programmers and others to design systems and to obtain information on project limitations and capabilities, performance requirements and interfaces.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Working out designs with other people is collaborative.

tasks.text: Monitor current reports of computer viruses to determine when to update virus protection systems.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Threat feeds and endpoint tools update protection automatically.

tasks.text: Modify computer security files to incorporate new software, correct errors, or change individual access status.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Access changes are increasingly handled by identity-management workflows.

tasks.text: Perform risk assessments and execute tests of data processing system to ensure functioning of data processing activities and security measures.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Scanners find weaknesses; the analyst judges risk and impact.

tasks.text: Document computer security and emergency measures policies, procedures, and tests.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI drafts policies; the analyst makes them fit the organisation.

tasks.text: Develop plans to safeguard computer files against accidental or unauthorized modification, destruction, or disclosure and to meet emergency data processing needs.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Planning protection uses AI analysis but needs human priorities.

tasks.text: Train users and promote security awareness to ensure system security and to improve server and network efficiency.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Changing people's security habits needs trust and teaching.

roles.onet_note: Closest O*NET occupation: Search Marketing Strategists.

tasks.text: Conduct market research analysis to identify search query trends, real-time search and news media activity, popular social media topics, electronic commerce trends, market opportunities, or competitor performance.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Trend and competitor monitoring is done by analytics platforms.

tasks.text: Coordinate sales or other promotional strategies with merchandising, operations, or inventory control staff to ensure product catalogs are current, accurate, and organized for best findability against user intent.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Product catalogues are kept current by feeds and AI tagging.

tasks.text: Conduct financial modeling for online marketing programs or Web site revenue forecasting.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Forecasts come from tools; the specialist sets assumptions.

tasks.text: Propose online or multiple-sales-channel campaigns to marketing executives.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI drafts campaign ideas and copy; the specialist chooses and pitches.

tasks.text: Participate in the development or implementation of online marketing strategy.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Strategy depends on brand, customers and judgement.

tasks.text: Communicate and collaborate with merchants, Webmasters, bloggers, or online editors to strategically place hyperlinks.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Partnerships rely on relationships.

roles.onet_note: Closest O*NET occupation: Web and Digital Interface Designers.

tasks.text: Create searchable indices for Web page content.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Search indexing is done by software.

tasks.text: Create Web models or prototypes that include physical, interface, logical, or data models.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI generates prototype drafts; the designer shapes them.

tasks.text: Design, build, or maintain Web sites, using authoring or scripting languages, content creation tools, management tools, and digital media.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Site builders and AI speed up building; quality is the designer's call.

tasks.text: Develop and document style guidelines for Web site content.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI can draft style guides from examples.

tasks.text: Conduct user research to determine design requirements and analyze user feedback to improve design quality.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Talking to users and reading their reactions needs empathy.

tasks.text: Confer with management or development teams to prioritize needs, resolve conflicts, develop content criteria, or choose solutions.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Resolving conflicting needs is negotiation.

roles.onet_note: Closest O*NET occupation: Solar Photovoltaic Installers.

tasks.text: Determine photovoltaic (PV) system designs or configurations based on factors such as customer needs, expectations, and site conditions.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Design software proposes layouts from site data; the technician checks the site.

tasks.text: Diagram layouts and locations for photovoltaic (PV) arrays and equipment, including existing building or site features.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Drones and mapping tools speed up diagrams.

tasks.text: Activate photovoltaic (PV) systems to verify system functionality and conformity to performance expectations.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Monitoring systems test output; the technician fixes faults.

tasks.text: Assemble solar modules, panels, or support structures, as specified.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Physical assembly on varied sites is hard to automate.

tasks.text: Install photovoltaic (PV) systems in accordance with codes and standards, using drawings, schematics, and instructions.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Installation on roofs and sites needs hands-on skill and safety judgement.

tasks.text: Apply weather sealing to array, building, or support mechanisms.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Weather sealing is manual work on each site.

tasks.text: Research or review regulatory, technical, or market issues related to sustainability.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI summarises regulations and reports; the analyst checks what applies.

tasks.text: Develop reports or presentations to communicate the effectiveness of sustainability initiatives.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI drafts reports and charts from data.

tasks.text: Write grant applications, rebate applications, or project proposals to secure funding for sustainability projects.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI drafts applications; the analyst tailors and stands behind them.

tasks.text: Review and revise sustainability proposals or policies.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI compares policies against standards; changes need human sign-off.

tasks.text: Identify or create new sustainability indicators.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Choosing what to measure reflects values and context.

tasks.text: Identify or investigate violations of natural resources, waste management, recycling, or other environmental policies.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Investigating violations needs site visits and judgement.

roles.onet_note: Closest O*NET occupation: Personal Care Aides.

tasks.text: Prepare and maintain records of client progress and services performed, reporting changes in client condition to manager or supervisor.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Voice notes and apps speed up care records.

tasks.text: Perform healthcare-related tasks, such as monitoring vital signs and medication, under the direction of registered nurses or physiotherapists.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Sensors and apps track vital signs; the carer acts on them.

tasks.text: Administer bedside or personal care, such as ambulation or personal hygiene assistance.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Personal care needs touch, dignity and trust.

tasks.text: Perform housekeeping duties, such as cooking, cleaning, washing clothes or dishes, or running errands.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Household tasks in varied homes remain manual.

tasks.text: Care for individuals or families during periods of incapacitation, family disruption, or convalescence, providing companionship, personal care, or help in adjusting to new lifestyles.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Companionship is human by nature.

tasks.text: Participate in case reviews, consulting with the team caring for the client, to evaluate the client's needs and plan for continuing services.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Case reviews depend on knowing the person.

roles.onet_note: ISCO 8212 Electrical and electronic equipment assemblers; O*NET Team Assemblers.

tasks.text: Perform quality checks on products and parts.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Automated optical inspection flags surface flaws while operators confirm complex defects.

tasks.text: Review work orders and blueprints to ensure work is performed according to specifications.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Digital displays and automated translation tools assist operators in reviewing assembly guidelines.

tasks.text: Rotate through all the tasks required in a particular production process.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Physical line rotations require human dexterity, physical presence, and situational awareness.

tasks.text: Provide assistance in the production of wiring assemblies.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Manual manipulation and precise routing of small wire harnesses require human motor skills.

tasks.text: Maintain production equipment and machinery.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Routine physical cleaning, clearing jams, and mechanical upkeep must be done manually on the line.

tasks.text: Complete production reports to communicate team production level to management.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: IoT sensors and automated production dashboards capture and compile output numbers automatically.

tasks.text: Package finished products and prepare them for shipment.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Boxing, taping, and organizing finished goods across dynamic order lines remain physical human tasks.

tasks.text: Receive payment by cash, check, credit cards, vouchers, or automatic debits.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Self-checkout terminals and contactless mobile payments directly process customer transactions without human cashier involvement.

tasks.text: Establish or identify prices of goods, services, or admission, and tabulate bills, using calculators, cash registers, or optical price scanners.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Automated barcode scanners, RFID readers, and smart shopping carts tally item prices automatically.

tasks.text: Issue receipts, refunds, credits, or change due to customers.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Digital POS platforms automatically generate e-receipts and issue electronic credit returns to customer accounts.

tasks.text: Greet customers entering establishments.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Offering a genuine, warm greeting to entering shoppers requires authentic human hospitality and social presence.

tasks.text: Assist customers by providing information and resolving their complaints.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Store lookup software assists staff with inventory data while the cashier exercises empathy to resolve customer complaints.

tasks.text: Count money in cash drawers at the beginning of shifts to ensure that amounts are correct and that there is adequate change.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Smart cash recyclers and automated counting hardware help staff rapidly verify cash drawer balances before a shift.

tasks.text: Process merchandise returns and exchanges.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: POS software automates return policy checks and receipt validation, while the cashier physically inspects damaged goods.

tasks.text: Greet, register, and assign rooms to guests of hotels or motels.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Self-service check-in kiosks and digital ID scanners speed up registration while clerks handle complex check-ins and personal greetings.

tasks.text: Make and confirm reservations.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Direct booking engines, travel aggregator APIs, and conversational AI handle standard room bookings without human intervention.

tasks.text: Compute bills, collect payments, and make change for guests.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Automated point-of-sale systems and digital payment gateways reconcile charges and process checkout transactions automatically.

tasks.text: Contact housekeeping or maintenance staff when guests report problems.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI dispatch platforms automatically route guest requests to maintenance or housekeeping staff based on location and priority.

tasks.text: Record guest comments or complaints, referring customers to managers as necessary.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: De-escalating upset guests and showing genuine empathy during service failures requires nuanced human emotional intelligence.

tasks.text: Answer inquiries pertaining to hotel services, guest registration, and travel directions, or make recommendations regarding shopping, dining, or entertainment.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI translation and recommendation tools help clerks quickly suggest local dining and attractions to international travelers.

tasks.text: Perform bookkeeping activities, such as balancing accounts and conducting nightly audits.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Property management systems with automated reconciliation algorithms perform night audits and balance ledgers with minimal oversight.

roles.onet_note: ISCO 9211 Crop farm labourers; O*NET Farmworkers and Laborers, Crop, Nursery, and Greenhouse.

tasks.text: Harvest fruits and vegetables by hand.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Manual dexterity and navigating difficult plantation terrain require human hands.

tasks.text: Plant, spray, weed, fertilize, water, and prune plants, shrubs, and trees, using gardening tools.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Physical fieldwork across varied estate topography relies directly on manual physical labour.

tasks.text: Identify plants, pests, and weeds to determine the selection and application of pesticides and fertilizers.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Mobile computer vision tools can assist workers in identifying crop diseases and pest infestations.

tasks.text: Participate in the inspection, grading, sorting, storage, and post-harvest treatment of crops.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Automated optical sorting and grading scanners help workers classify produce quality faster.

tasks.text: Record information about crops, such as pesticide use, yields, or costs.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Digital logbooks and mobile apps streamline the recording of harvest volumes and pesticide applications.

tasks.text: Operate tractors, tractor-drawn machinery, and self-propelled machinery to plow, harrow and fertilize soil, or to plant, cultivate, spray and harvest crops.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Navigating rugged agricultural fields and machinery safely continues to need hands-on human control.

tasks.text: Load agricultural products into trucks, and drive trucks to market or storage facilities.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Heavy physical lifting, loading fresh fruit bunches, and transport across rural tracks require human physical effort.

roles.onet_note: O*NET Architectural and Civil Drafters; ISCO 3118 Draughtspersons.

tasks.text: Produce drawings, using computer-assisted drafting systems (CAD) or drafting machines, or by hand, using compasses, dividers, protractors, triangles, and other drafting devices.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Generative drafting and CAD plugins assist technicians by accelerating routine line work and auto-generating standard views.

tasks.text: Draft plans and detailed drawings for structures, installations, and construction projects, such as highways, sewage disposal systems, and dikes, working from sketches or notes.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Parametric AI tools speed up plan generation from sketches, but technicians must verify structural layouts.

tasks.text: Coordinate structural, electrical, and mechanical designs and determine a method of presentation to graphically represent building plans.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: BIM tools automatically detect clashes between MEP and structural elements, while the technician coordinates the resolution.

tasks.text: Analyze building codes, by-laws, space and site requirements, and other technical documents and reports to determine their effect on architectural designs.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI document extraction tools scan building bylaws to highlight non-compliance for the technician to review.

tasks.text: Check dimensions of materials to be used and assign numbers to lists of materials.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: BIM software automatically schedules and tallies dimensions and material quantities directly from digital models.

tasks.text: Explain drawings to production or construction teams and provide adjustments as necessary.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Explaining designs to site engineers and local contractors requires direct interpersonal communication and contextual judgment.

tasks.text: Represent architect or engineer on construction site, ensuring builder compliance with design specifications and advising on design corrections, under supervision.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: On-site inspection to verify builder compliance requires physical presence and real-time situational assessment.

tasks.text: Check figures, postings, and documents for correct entry, mathematical accuracy, and proper codes.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: AI document extraction automatically verifies figures, postings, and tax codes across receipts and invoices without manual checking.

tasks.text: Classify, record, and summarize numerical and financial data to compile and keep financial records, using journals and ledgers or computers.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Cloud accounting systems automatically classify and post routine ledger entries using predefined rule sets and machine-learned patterns.

tasks.text: Match order forms with invoices, and record the necessary information.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Automated three-way matching systems cross-reference purchase orders, delivery orders, and invoices electronically.

tasks.text: Prepare and process payroll information.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Payroll systems automate statutory rate calculations, but clerks must still review irregular allowances, medical claims, and overtime hours.

tasks.text: Reconcile records of bank transactions.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Bank feeds suggest automated matches, while the clerk manually reviews unmatched line items and payment exceptions.

tasks.text: Reconcile or note and report discrepancies found in records.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Investigating disputed payments, contact with suppliers, and resolving undocumented discrepancies require direct human communication and problem-solving.

tasks.text: Complete and submit tax forms and returns, workers' compensation forms, pension contribution forms, and other government documents.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Statutory software prepares EPF, SOCSO, and tax filings, while the clerk verifies totals and handles final portal submission.

roles.onet_note: O*NET Logisticians; ISCO has no logistician code, closest is 2421 Management and organization analysts.

tasks.text: Direct availability and allocation of materials, supplies, and finished products.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI forecasting tools optimize inventory allocation while specialists manage real-world stock constraints and supplier lead times.

tasks.text: Redesign the movement of goods to maximize value and minimize costs.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI models suggest optimal freight routes and network designs, which specialists validate against local infrastructure and cost realities.

tasks.text: Collaborate with other departments as necessary to meet customer requirements, to take advantage of sales opportunities or, in the case of shortages, to minimize negative impacts on a business.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Cross-functional alignment and crisis negotiation during product shortages require human relationship management and judgment.

tasks.text: Review logistics performance with customers against targets, benchmarks, and service agreements.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI dashboards monitor SLA metrics in real time while specialists handle performance discussions and client negotiations.

tasks.text: Manage subcontractor activities, reviewing proposals, developing performance specifications, and serving as liaisons between subcontractors and organizations.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Subcontractor selection, relationship management, and contract enforcement rely heavily on interpersonal trust and human evaluation.

tasks.text: Report project plans, progress, and results.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Automated reporting tools and workflow integrations generate logistics status reports directly from ERP systems.

tasks.text: Stay informed of logistics technology advances and apply appropriate technology to improve logistics processes.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Evaluating and adopting new warehouse and freight technologies requires strategic business insight and contextual assessment.

tasks.text: Receive checks and cash for deposit, verify amounts, and check accuracy of deposit slips.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Cash deposit machines and optical character recognition increasingly verify slips, notes, and cheque deposits automatically.

tasks.text: Cash checks and pay out money after verifying that signatures are correct, that written and numerical amounts agree, and that accounts have sufficient funds.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Automated teller machines and digital fund transfers replace most over-the-counter cheque cashing and cash withdrawals.

tasks.text: Enter customers' transactions into computers to record transactions and issue computer-generated receipts.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Core banking systems and digital banking platforms log transactions and generate electronic receipts automatically.

tasks.text: Balance currency, coin, and checks in cash drawers at ends of shifts and calculate daily transactions, using computers, calculators, or adding machines.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Automated cash recyclers and smart vault software tally cash counts, while tellers handle physical sign-offs and variance reviews.

tasks.text: Resolve problems or discrepancies concerning customers' accounts.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI diagnostic tools help flag transaction errors and account holds, while tellers manage customer interaction and remediation.

tasks.text: Explain, promote, or sell products or services, such as travelers' checks, savings bonds, money orders, and cashier's checks, using computerized information about customers to tailor recommendations.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Customer intelligence engines suggest relevant financial products, but tellers explain features and build rapport with clients.

tasks.text: Answer telephones and assist customers with their questions.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Supporting branch visitors with complex queries and emotional distress relies on interpersonal tact and human empathy.

tasks.text: Record patients' medical information and vital signs.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI-connected telemetry and automated charting capture vital signs, but nurses verify readings and correlate them with patient status.

tasks.text: Administer medications to patients and monitor patients for reactions or side effects.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Administering medications and observing subtle clinical reactions require direct human bedside presence and sensory observation.

tasks.text: Maintain accurate, detailed reports and records.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Document extraction and language tools help summarize nursing notes, though nurses must validate the record.

tasks.text: Monitor, record, and report symptoms or changes in patients' conditions.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Clinical decision support systems flag early deterioration trends, but the nurse evaluates the patient's holistic presentation.

tasks.text: Consult and coordinate with healthcare team members to assess, plan, implement, or evaluate patient care plans.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Interprofessional rounds and multi-specialty care planning require collaborative dialogue, bedside context, and clinical judgment.

tasks.text: Prepare patients for and assist with examinations or treatments.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Hands-on physical preparation, positioning, and calming anxious patients during procedures require physical dexterity and empathy.

tasks.text: Instruct individuals, families, or other groups on topics such as health education, disease prevention, or childbirth and develop health improvement programs.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Generative tools assist in drafting accessible patient education materials, while the nurse delivers contextual guidance to families.

tasks.text: Supervise and monitor students' use of tools and equipment.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Physical workshop safety and direct manual supervision must be actively managed by a human instructor.

tasks.text: Observe and evaluate students' work to determine progress, provide feedback, and make suggestions for improvement.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Evaluating physical craftsmanship, manual dexterity, and practical technique requires real-time human observation.

tasks.text: Conduct on-the-job training classes or training sessions to teach and demonstrate principles, techniques, procedures, or methods of designated subjects.
tasks.label: human
tasks.reason: Demonstrating tactile procedures and tool operations requires physical presence and real-time interaction.

tasks.text: Present lectures and conduct discussions to increase students' knowledge and competence using visual aids, such as graphs, charts, videotapes, and slides.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Generative media and AI presentation tools help instructors rapidly design engaging visual aids and instructional slides.

tasks.text: Administer oral, written, or performance tests to measure progress and to evaluate training effectiveness.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: AI can formulate written question banks and analyze test statistics while instructors oversee practical assessments.

tasks.text: Develop curricula and plan course content and methods of instruction.
tasks.label: assist
tasks.reason: Instructors can use AI workflows to align course outlines quickly with evolving industrial competency standards.

tasks.text: Prepare reports and maintain records, such as student grades, attendance rolls, and training activity details.
tasks.label: automate
tasks.reason: Document processing systems can automate routine attendance tracking, mark calculation, and institutional reporting.
